abstract: The position of enterprises within supply chain networks, as a core element of enterprise social networks, has an important impact on supply chain resilience. Using panel data on non-financial firms listed in China’s A-share market from 2014 to 2023, this study empirically examines how supply chain network centrality affects supply chain resilience, as well as the mediating role of dynamic capabilities and the moderating role of ESG performance. The results show that supply chain network centrality can significantly influence enterprise supply chain resilience. Enterprises located at the core of the network can better withstand diverse risk shocks by exploiting their positional advantages in information acquisition and resource integration. Further analysis indicates that dynamic capabilities constitute an important mediating channel between supply chain network centrality and resilience, and ESG performance positively moderates it. The heterogeneity analysis reveals that manufacturing firms, state-owned enterprises, and high-tech firms are more reliant on network centrality to enhance supply chain resilience. This paper proposes that firms should prioritize the strategic synergy among network centrality, dynamic capability cultivation, and ESG performance. Meanwhile, policymakers should endeavour to promote the construction of supply chain collaborative networks, refine ESG incentive mechanisms, and implement differentiated industry support policies. KEYWORDS: Network centrality supply chain resilience dynamic capabilities ESG performance supply chain network JEL CLASSIFICATION: G34 L22 O47
abstract_zh: 企业在供应链网络中的位置作为企业社会网络的核心要素，对供应链韧性具有重要影响。本研究利用2014年至2023年中国A股市场非金融类上市公司的面板数据，实证检验了供应链网络中心度对供应链韧性的影响，以及动态能力的中介作用和ESG绩效的调节作用。研究结果表明，供应链网络中心度能够显著影响企业供应链韧性。位于网络核心位置的企业能够利用其在信息获取和资源整合方面的位置优势，更好地抵御各类风险冲击。进一步分析表明，动态能力是供应链网络中心度与供应链韧性之间的重要中介渠道，且ESG绩效对此具有正向调节作用。异质性分析显示，制造业企业、国有企业和科技型企业更加依赖网络中心度来提升供应链韧性。本文提出，企业应重视网络中心度、动态能力培育与ESG绩效之间的战略协同。同时，政策制定者应努力推动供应链协同网络建设，完善ESG激励机制，并实施差异化的产业支持政策。关键词：网络中心度 供应链韧性 动态能力 ESG绩效 供应链网络 JEL分类：G34 L22 O47

title: How does supply chain network centrality affect supply chain resilience: an empirical study of Chinese listed firms
title_zh: 供应链网络中心性如何影响供应链韧性：来自中国上市公司的实证研究

abstract: Federal judges—who enjoy lifetime tenure and constitutionally protected salaries—represent an especially hard test case for incentive-based bureaucratic reform. I study the “six-month list,” a reform requiring U.S. federal courts to publicly identify judges with overdue matters. Using a regression discontinuity design and other methods, I find that matters most exposed are resolved approximately 14% faster than those least exposed, with larger effects among younger, non-white, and female judges. The speed gains come with trade-offs: upfront time savings are partially offset by downstream delays, and more-exposed matters are more likely to be reversed on appeal. A bunching analysis estimates aggregate time savings of approximately 4%, demonstrating that non-monetary levers can shift behavior even among highly insulated elite professionals.
abstract_zh: 联邦法官——享有终身任期及宪法保障的薪酬——构成了基于激励的官僚改革中尤为严峻的考验案例。我研究了“六个月清单”这一改革，该改革要求美国联邦法院公开识别存在逾期未决案件的法官。利用断点回归设计及其他方法，我发现，暴露程度最高的案件比暴露程度最低的案件解决速度快约14%，且在较年轻、非白人及女性法官中效果更为显著。速度提升伴随权衡：前期时间节省部分被后续延误所抵消，且暴露程度更高的案件更有可能在上诉中被推翻。通过聚束分析估计，总体时间节省约为4%，这表明即使在高度隔离的精英专业人士中，非货币杠杆也能改变行为。
title: Non-monetary incentives and bureaucratic performance: Evidence from U.S. courts
title_zh: 非货币激励与官僚绩效：来自美国法院的证据

abstract: Selecting the right CEO is critical to firm success, yet boards must evaluate candidates before observing future performance. This paper examines whether machine learning can improve the hard‑information component of CEO selection by using appointment‑time public information to predict early CEO turnover. Using CEO appointments in Chinese listed firms from 2004 to 2022, we apply XGBoost to predict performance-induced turnover and forced turnover within 2 years of appointment. XGBoost yields stronger out-of-sample predictions than AIC-selected OLS and logit models, and its prediction gains map into decision-relevant screening outcomes. Candidate-pool analyses show that XGBoost rankings remain informative against internal and external benchmarks. SHAP-based interpretation reveals that the model identifies both conventional and unconventional predictors, along with important interactions. Further, the model performs better in non-state-owned firms, suggesting algorithmic screening is most useful where CEO evaluation is market-driven. Overall, our findings suggest machine learning can provide a complementary, auditable screening benchmark for CEO selection. KEYWORDS: CEO selection machine learning XGBoost CEO turnover model interpretation JEL CLASSIFICATION: C10 G30 M12 M51 Acknowledgements The authors thank Jianjun Jia, Guangwei Li, Lei Wang and Su Wang for their helpful comments and suggestions, as well as seminar participants at ShanghaiTech University, the 2023 Pacific-Basin Finance Journal Special Issue Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Corporate Finance, and the internal conference at Shanghai University of International Business and Economics for helpful discussions.
abstract_zh: 选择合适的CEO对企业成功至关重要，然而董事会必须在观察未来业绩之前评估候选人。本文探讨了机器学习能否通过利用任命时的公开信息预测CEO早期更替，从而改善CEO选拔中的硬信息组成部分。利用2004年至2022年中国上市公司的CEO任命数据，我们应用XGBoost预测任命后两年内因业绩导致的更替和强制更替。XGBoost在样本外预测方面优于基于AIC选择的OLS和Logit模型，其预测增益转化为决策相关的筛选结果。候选人池分析显示，XGBoost排名在内部和外部基准下仍具有信息量。基于SHAP的解释揭示，该模型识别了传统和非传统的预测因子，以及重要的交互作用。此外，该模型在非国有企业中表现更佳，表明算法筛选在CEO评估以市场为导向时最为有用。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，机器学习可以为CEO选拔提供一种互补且可审计的筛选基准。关键词：CEO选拔；机器学习；XGBoost；CEO更替；模型解释 JEL分类：C10 G30 M12 M51 致谢：作者感谢Jianjun Jia、Guangwei Li、Lei Wang和Su Wang的有益评论与建议，以及上海科技大学、2023年《太平洋盆地金融杂志》关于公司金融中人工智能与机器学习的特刊会议和上海对外经贸大学内部会议的与会者们的有益讨论。

title: Can machine learning improve CEO selection?

abstract: Mitigating local government debt risks is essential for safeguarding economic and financial stability. As a key instrument of structural deleveraging, the local government debt replacement programme may generate important spillover effects on firms, yet its microeconomic consequences and transmission mechanisms remain underexplored. Using China’s first-round LGDR programme during 2015–2018 as a quasi-natural experiment and a sample covering 248 prefecture-level cities, this study employs an intensity-based difference-in-differences approach to examine the impact of local government debt replacement on corporate investment efficiency and its underlying mechanisms. The results show that local government debt replacement significantly improves corporate investment efficiency. Mechanism analyses provide evidence consistent with two potential channels: improvements in firms’ external financing conditions and internal managerial efficiency. Heterogeneity analyses further reveal that the positive effect is stronger for non-state-owned firms, technology-intensive firms, and firms operating in competitive industries. This study enriches the literature on the microeconomic effects of local debt governance policies and provides new evidence on how debt-risk mitigation policies improve resource allocation and investment efficiency at the firm level. KEYWORDS: Local government debt replacement corporate investment efficiency intensity DID quantile regression JEL CLASSIFICATION: G38 E65
abstract_zh: 化解地方政府债务风险对于维护经济金融稳定至关重要。作为结构性去杠杆的关键工具，地方政府债务置换计划可能对企业产生重要的溢出效应，但其微观经济后果及传导机制尚未得到充分探讨。本文以2015—2018年中国首轮地方政府债务置换计划作为准自然实验，利用覆盖248个地级市层面的样本，采用基于强度的双重差分方法，考察地方政府债务置换对企业投资效率的影响及其内在机制。研究结果表明，地方政府债务置换显著提升了企业投资效率。机制分析提供了与两条潜在渠道相一致的证据：企业外部融资条件的改善和内部管理效率的提升。异质性分析进一步揭示，对于非国有企业、技术密集型企业以及处于竞争性行业的企业而言，这一积极效应更为显著。本研究丰富了关于地方债务治理政策微观经济效应的文献，并为债务风险化解政策如何改善企业层面的资源配置与投资效率提供了新的证据。关键词：地方政府债务置换；企业投资效率；强度DID；分位数回归 JEL分类：G38；E65

title: Does local government debt replacement affect corporate investment efficiency? Evidence from China
title_zh: 地方政府债务置换是否影响企业投资效率？来自中国的证据

abstract: This paper evaluates the impact of the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) on trade, productivity, and welfare using a multi‐country, multi‐sector Ricardian model with input–output linkages. Gravity estimates reveal asymmetric trade effects: BRI participation increases imports from China in textiles, wood and paper, and electrical machinery, while raising exports to China in metals. These effects are not driven by tariff reductions and are stronger among countries with regional trade agreements (RTAs) with China in several sectors. I then recover model‐implied country‐sector productivity and estimate its response to BRI participation using difference‐in‐differences methods. I find no broad productivity gains from BRI participation. Instead, sectors whose input needs are more closely matched with China's upstream exports experience stronger productivity growth relative to other sectors within the same country, becoming significant in the third year after participation. Counterfactual simulations show that removing the estimated trade cost and productivity effects reduces welfare in BRI countries and China, while generating smaller losses for non‐BRI countries. When the United States raises tariffs on China, China's welfare loss is slightly larger in the absence of the BRI, suggesting that the BRI provides a modest buffer against adverse tariff shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文利用一个包含投入产出关联的多国、多部门李嘉图模型，评估了“一带一路”倡议（BRI）对贸易、生产率和福利的影响。引力模型估计揭示了不对称的贸易效应：参与BRI增加了从中国进口的纺织品、木材与纸张以及电气机械，同时提高了向中国出口的金属产品。这些效应并非由关税削减驱动，且在多个部门中，与中国签订区域贸易协定（RTAs）的国家中效应更为显著。随后，我恢复了模型隐含的国家-部门生产率，并采用双重差分法估计其对BRI参与的响应。我发现BRI参与并未带来广泛的生产率提升。相反，其投入需求与中国上游出口更为匹配的部门，在同一国家内相对于其他部门经历了更强的生产率增长，并在参与后的第三年变得显著。反事实模拟显示，消除估计的贸易成本和生产率效应会降低BRI国家和中国的福利，而对非BRI国家造成的损失较小。当美国对中国提高关税时，若无BRI，中国的福利损失略大，这表明BRI为应对不利关税冲击提供了适度的缓冲。

title: Barriers and Bridges: The Trade, Productivity, and Welfare Effects of the Belt and Road Initiative

abstract: Substantive agri-environmental policy change has not materialized within EU agri-food governance despite emerging scientific consensus on the need for food system transformation. Agri-environmental legislative proposals often face strong resistance, resulting in their weakening or reversal. Although the challenges to adopting agri-environmental legislations are clear, existing analytical tools fall short in explaining why legislative rollbacks occur. This study addresses this gap by drawing on Rational Choice Theory to examine how individual-level motivations linked to the agri-food sector influence members of the European Parliament (MEP) voting behaviour on agri-environmental legislation. Roll-call vote data and a binomial generalized linear mixed model are used to test office-seeking, policy-seeking and vote-seeking motivations. Our analysis shows that MEPs with private financial interests in the agri-food sector were more likely to vote against environmental protection across the studied agri-environmental legislations, while MEPs with stronger environmental ideological affinity were more likely to support such measures. Institutional variables, mainly political group affiliation and COMAGRI leadership of legislative files, are also significant determinants of voting behaviour. These findings suggest that individual-level motivations and institutional structures help explain the lack of consistent legislative support for agri-environmental legislations between February 2022 and July 2024. Our findings raise normative questions about the need for stronger transparency and conflict-of-interest measures in EU agricultural governance.
abstract_zh: 尽管科学界对食品体系转型的必要性已形成共识，欧盟农业食品治理中实质性的农业环境政策变革仍未实现。农业环境立法提案常遭遇强烈抵制，导致其被削弱或逆转。尽管采纳农业环境立法的挑战显而易见，现有分析工具却难以解释立法倒退何以发生。本研究通过借鉴理性选择理论，探讨与农业食品部门相关的个体层面动机如何影响欧洲议会（MEP）议员在农业环境立法上的投票行为，以填补这一研究空白。研究采用唱名表决数据及二项广义线性混合模型，检验了追求职位、追求政策及追求选票三类动机。分析结果显示，在农业食品部门拥有私人财务利益的欧洲议会议员更倾向于在研究的各项农业环境立法中投票反对环境保护，而具有更强环境意识形态倾向的议员则更可能支持此类措施。制度变量，主要是政治团体归属及立法档案的COMAGRI主导权，也是投票行为的重要决定因素。这些发现表明，个体层面动机与制度结构共同解释了2022年2月至2024年7月期间农业环境立法缺乏一贯立法支持的现象。我们的研究结果引发了关于欧盟农业治理中加强透明度与利益冲突管理措施必要性的规范性思考。
title: Voting green, or not: what drives members of the European Parliament opposition to agri-environmental reform?
title_zh: 投票绿色，还是不投票：什么驱动欧洲议会议员反对农业环境改革？

abstract: Millions of people are resettled each year when dam construction floods their homes and land. Dam building and its associated resettlement may impact water security by altering access to drinking water and sanitation, disrupting aquatic ecosystems, shifting local economies, and undermining the ability to use rivers for income, navigation, and cultural practices. This paper explores how dam-induced-displacement and resettlement in the Brazilian Amazon shaped women’s experiences of water (in)security along four dimensions: Access, Safety, Livelihoods, and Culture. We conducted in-depth interviews with 70 women in the city of Altamira who were impacted by the Belo Monte Dam and who had participated in household surveys before dam construction began. Our findings suggest that dam building and resettlement did not universally improve or degrade water security, but rather shifted it in uneven ways. While access to water improved for some women, the majority of respondents experienced water outages after the dam, some for weeks at a time. Safety from seasonal flooding and access to sanitation improved for many, though poor water quality and lack of maintenance of sanitation infrastructure created problems. Finally, resettlement and changes in river ecology undermined livelihoods for fisheries-dependent households and severed cultural connections to the river for many. These findings have crucial implications for health outcomes and can inform policies to improve the water security and well-being of populations resettled due to future dams, other development projects, and climate change.
abstract_zh: 每年，大坝建设淹没房屋和土地，导致数百万人被迫迁移。大坝建设及其相关的重新安置可能通过改变饮用水和卫生设施的获取途径、破坏水生生态系统、改变当地经济，以及削弱利用河流进行生计、航行和文化实践的能力，从而影响水安全。本文探讨了巴西亚马逊地区因大坝引发的流离失所和重新安置如何从四个维度——获取、安全、生计和文化——塑造了女性的水（不）安全体验。我们对阿尔塔米拉市的70名受贝洛蒙特水坝影响且在建设前参与过家庭调查的女性进行了深度访谈。研究结果表明，大坝建设和重新安置并未普遍改善或恶化水安全，而是以不均衡的方式改变了它。尽管部分女性的取水条件有所改善，但大多数受访者在大坝建成后经历了停水，有些甚至持续数周。对于许多人来说，季节性洪水的安全性和卫生设施的获取有所提升，但水质差和卫生设施维护不足带来了新的问题。最后，重新安置和河流生态的变化削弱了依赖渔业的家庭的生计，并切断了许多人与河流的文化联系。这些发现对健康结果具有重要影响，可为改善因未来大坝、其他开发项目及气候变化而重新安置的人口的用水安全和福祉提供政策参考。
title: Hydropower development, resettlement, and urban water security: Evidence from Brazil’s Belo Monte Dam
title_zh: 水电开发、移民安置与城市水安全：来自巴西贝罗蒙特大坝的证据

abstract: Land tenure security plays a vital role in promoting sustainable land management, but its impact on soil health remains poorly understood within Uganda's complex tenure systems. This study examines how formal land certification and tenure systems influence soil health outcomes using data from the Uganda National Panel Survey (2020/2021) and robust econometric methods, including ordinary least squares, instrumental variables, and propensity score matching. We constructed the soil health index by combining five key variables, namely organic matter, biodiversity, erosion control, fertilizer use, and fallow practices, with each factor weighted based on its importance. To reduce endogeneity, we used instrumental variables like historical land reform and distance to land registry offices. The results indicate that formal land certification enhances soil health, with leasehold and freehold land systems demonstrating the most substantial positive effects. Nonetheless, the impacts of land certification differ by tenure system. Certification of land combined with customary tenure has a significant impact on soil health, whereas certification within customary systems proves ineffective, underscoring the need for supplementary interventions. Conversely, inherited land and households led by widows are associated with negative outcomes for soil health, which may reflect issues of land fragmentation and resource limitations. Analysis of heterogeneity of the impact of land certification reveals that Mailo and Leasehold land tenure systems benefit from land certification. In contrast, Freehold systems exhibit negative returns, potentially due to existing security arrangements. We recommend including scaling up Uganda's Certificates of Customary Ownership while integrating gender-sensitive support, education, and credit access to maximize the benefits of soil health.
abstract_zh: 土地权属保障在促进可持续土地管理中发挥着至关重要的作用，但其对土壤健康的影响在乌干达复杂的土地制度体系中仍未得到充分理解。本研究利用乌干达全国面板调查（2020/2021）数据，并采用稳健的计量经济学方法，包括普通最小二乘法、工具变量法和倾向得分匹配法，考察正式土地确权证书和土地制度对土壤健康结果的影响。我们通过综合五个关键变量构建了土壤健康指数，即有机质、生物多样性、侵蚀控制、化肥使用和休耕实践，并根据各因素的重要性赋予权重。为减少内生性问题，我们使用了历史土地改革和距土地登记处距离等工具变量。结果表明，正式土地确权证书能够改善土壤健康，其中租赁权和自由保有土地制度展现出最为显著的正向效应。然而，土地确权的影响因土地制度而异。土地确权与习惯保有制度相结合对土壤健康具有显著影响，而习惯制度内部的土地确权则效果有限，凸显了补充干预措施的必要性。相反，继承土地和寡妇户主家庭与土壤健康负面结果相关，这可能反映了土地碎片化和资源限制的问题。对土地确权影响的异质性分析显示，Mailo和租赁权土地制度受益于土地确权。相比之下，自由保有制度表现出负向回报，可能归因于现有的安全保障安排。我们建议扩大乌干达习惯保有所有权证书的推广范围，同时纳入性别敏感支持、教育和信贷获取渠道，以最大化土壤健康的收益。
title: Land tenure security and soil health: Evidence from Uganda
title_zh: 土地权属安全与土壤健康：来自乌干达的证据

abstract: The literature on same-sex marriage has primarily focused on the effects of legal recognition, overlooking other factors that influence marriage decisions among same-sex couples. This study provides novel evidence on the role of political context by analyzing how the election of a homophobic leader affects these decisions. Using the case of Brazil, we examine the effect of revealed local support for the openly homophobic Jair Bolsonaro in the presidential elections on same-sex marriage dynamics. To estimate this effect, we apply a difference-in-differences approach with varying treatment intensity. The results show a significant increase in same-sex marriages in municipalities with higher support for Bolsonaro during the period between the election and the beginning of his presidential term. These findings suggest that perceived threats of rights restrictions can trigger immediate and significant personal decisions among minority groups, even in the absence of legal changes.

abstract: To address rising income inequality, governments typically rely on two levers: predistribution policies that implement inequality reduction before incomes are earned—e.g., minimum-wage laws—and redistribution policies that implement inequality reduction after incomes are earned—e.g., taxes and transfers. We explore whether support for reducing inequality depends on the choice of policy lever. Using incentivized experiments with the general population of the US and Sweden ( N = 2510 ), we study inequality reduction under predistribution and redistribution, focusing on whether inequality reduction is implemented before or after income is earned. We find that timing matters: subjects in both countries reduce inequality more under predistribution than redistribution. Furthermore, subjects in the predistribution treatment more often invoke equal effort to justify reducing inequality, while those in the redistribution treatment more often invoke adherence to the initial agreement to justify preserving it. Overall, our results imply that the choice between predistribution and redistribution can influence public support for reducing inequality.
abstract_zh: 为应对日益加剧的收入不平等，政府通常依赖两种手段：一是事前分配政策，即在收入产生之前实施不平等削减，如最低工资法；二是再分配政策，即在收入产生之后实施不平等削减，如税收和转移支付。我们探讨了减少不平等的支持度是否取决于政策手段的选择。通过对美国和瑞典普通人群的激励性实验（样本量N=2510），我们研究了事前分配与再分配下的不平等削减，重点关注不平等削减是在收入赚取之前还是之后实施。我们发现时机至关重要：两国受试者在事前分配下比在再分配下更倾向于减少不平等。此外，事前分配处理中的受试者更常援引平等努力来为减少不平等辩护，而再分配处理中的受试者则更常援引对初始协议的遵守来为维持不平等辩护。总体而言，我们的结果表明，事前分配与再分配之间的选择可能影响公众对减少不平等的支持度。

abstract: Policy narratives in the US on China have undergone a dramatic transformation in recent years. This column draws on various kinds of public records and employs text-as-data methods to examine the evolution of the US discourse on China over time and also across different sources of public narrative. Whereas the 19th century demonstrates oscillating trends, a clearer pattern emerges in the latter half of the 20th century, one driven less by fluctuating developments and more by ideological and political patterns. The overall trends in net sentiment suggest an interesting contrast between presidential discourse and other sources, with presidential speech appearing to have been a follower.
abstract_zh: 近年来，美国对华政策叙事经历了戏剧性的转变。本文基于多种公共记录，运用文本即数据的方法，考察了美国对华话语随时间演变的情况，以及不同公共叙事来源间的差异。尽管19世纪呈现出波动趋势，但20世纪后半叶则显现出更为清晰的模式，这一模式更多受意识形态和政治格局驱动，而非不断变化的事件。总体情感趋势显示，总统话语与其他来源之间存在有趣的对比，总统演讲似乎更多是跟随者而非引领者。

abstract: Trade in critical metals essential for electrification has become centred on China over the last three decades. This column introduces a new framework in which network centrality depends on strategic decisions and investments. It shows that the central position of China does not originate from resource endowments but from processing capacity. Furthermore, supply shocks to these metals raise inflation in both the US and EU, with larger and more persistent effects than shocks to oil and gas. To ensure supply-chain security, the EU needs to focus on adding processing capacity capable of responding when supply is restricted.
abstract_zh: 过去三十年间，对电气化至关重要的关键金属贸易已日益集中于中国。本文介绍了一个新框架，其中网络中心性取决于战略决策与投资。研究表明，中国的中心地位并非源于资源禀赋，而是来自加工能力。此外，这些金属的供应冲击会推高美国和欧盟的通胀，其影响比石油和天然气冲击更大且更持久。为确保供应链安全，欧盟需着力增加能够在供应受限时作出响应的加工能力。

abstract: We study how policy expectations affect the estimated natural rate of interest (r*) for the United States and the euro area. To discipline policy expectations, we incorporate information on future policy rates and long-term yields in episodes when the Fed and ECB provided forward guidance. For the post-Covid period, we find that r* rises much more than in an otherwise standard specification that omits yield-curve observables. By implication, the post-Covid tightening of the monetary policy stance was not nearly as large as standard r* models imply, which helps explain why economic activity did not slow much when nominal policy rates were raised dramatically in 2022 to fight inflationary pressures. Yield-curve information pins down anticipated policy innovations and alters r* estimates and, thus, the monetary policy stance.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了政策预期如何影响美国和欧元区的自然利率（r*）估计。为了约束政策预期，我们纳入了美联储和欧洲央行在提供前瞻指引期间关于未来政策利率和长期收益率的信息。对于后疫情时期，我们发现r*的上升幅度远大于省略收益率曲线观测值的标准规格所显示的水平。这意味着，后疫情时期的货币政策立场收紧程度远没有标准r*模型所暗示的那么大，这有助于解释为何在2022年名义政策利率大幅上调以对抗通胀压力时，经济活动并未显著放缓。收益率曲线信息锁定了预期的政策创新，并改变了r*估计值，从而影响了货币政策立场。

abstract: We explore the historical link between populist regimes, fiscal monetization, and inflation, and how these links affect monetary policy in the 21st century. Using data for a large set of advanced economies and emerging markets since 1960, we show that, historically, left-leaning populist regimes are linked to increases in central bank lending to the central government, a gauge of deficit monetization. In turn, central bank lending is associated with marked increases in inflation. We show that past exposure to populism that relied on deficit monetization affects the conduct of monetary policy today. Countries with a history of deficit monetization and left-wing populist regimes systematically respond more strongly to deviations of inflation expectations from target. This effect persists even after controlling for the direct effect of past inflation on monetary policy rules. In the context of the literature of experienced learning, this novel finding sheds light on the persistence of past populist policies---central banks operating under the shadow of past populist regimes that relied on inflation-prone deficit monetization continue today needing to send stronger signals of their independence and commitment to price stability to effectively anchor inflation expectations.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了民粹主义政权、财政货币化与通货膨胀之间的历史联系，以及这些联系如何影响21世纪的货币政策。利用自1960年以来涵盖众多发达经济体和新兴市场的数据，我们表明，历史上，左倾民粹主义政权与中央银行对中央政府的贷款增加相关联，这反映了赤字货币化的一个指标。进而，中央银行贷款与通货膨胀的显著上升相关联。我们证明，过去依赖赤字货币化的民粹主义经历会影响当今货币政策的实施。具有赤字货币化和左翼民粹主义政权历史的国家，系统性地对通胀预期偏离目标的情况作出更强烈的反应。即使在控制了过往通胀对货币政策规则的直接影响后，这一效应依然存在。在经验学习的文献背景下，这一新颖发现揭示了过往民粹主义政策的持续性——在依赖易引发通胀的赤字货币化的过往民粹主义政权阴影下运作的中央银行，如今仍需发出更强烈的独立性和对价格稳定承诺的信号，以有效锚定通胀预期。

abstract: Using a small open economy overlapping generations model, this paper examines how AI can drive economic divergence across and within Asian economies. While AI adoption may promise sizable productivity gains, it could create temporary but potentially longlasting divergence across countries. Structurally-prepared advanced economies tend to adopt AI earlier and see immediate growth gains while emerging markets and developing economies (EMDEs) face delayed adoption and initial growth headwinds from rising costs of capital. Structural reforms that boost productivity and strengthen human capital not only accelerate adoption in EMDEs but also amplify the growth gains. Within countries, AI adoption could widen inequality along multiple dimensions: across skill groups, as high-skilled workers benefit disproportionately from complementarity with the more capital-intensive technology, and across generation, as the shift of national income toward capital favors asset-rich older households relative to younger workers who rely primarily on labor income. Redistributive policies can help mitigate these distributional pressures, though they entail equity efficiency trade-offs that vary with country-specific fiscal and demographic conditions.
abstract_zh: 本文运用小型开放经济重叠世代模型，探讨人工智能如何驱动亚洲各经济体之间及其内部的经济分化。尽管采用人工智能可能带来可观的生产率提升，却也可能引发各国间暂时但可能持久的分化。结构性准备充分的发达经济体往往较早采用人工智能，并立即获得增长收益，而新兴市场和发展中经济体则面临采用延迟及资本成本上升带来的初期增长阻力。提升生产率并强化人力资本的结构性改革，不仅能加速新兴市场和发展中经济体的技术采用，还能放大增长收益。在国家内部，人工智能的采用可能从多个维度加剧不平等：在技能群体之间，高技能劳动者因与资本密集型技术的互补性而获益不成比例；在代际之间，国民收入向资本倾斜，有利于资产丰厚的老年家庭，而不利于主要依赖劳动收入的年轻劳动者。再分配政策有助于缓解这些分配压力，但需权衡公平与效率，其取舍因各国财政与人口状况而异。
authors: Ms. Natasha X Che & Weining Xin & Taichi Yoshida
title: AI and Economic Divergence in Asia
title_zh: 人工智能与亚洲经济分化

abstract: This paper examines the divergent economic development paths of Mauritius, Seychelles, Madagascar, and Comoros since 1980. Despite operating in broadly similar regional and geographic settings, Mauritius and Seychelles achieved significantly higher levels of real GDP per capita, while Madagascar and Comoros saw more limited progress. Combining qualitative analysis with panel econometric methods (FMOLS and DOLS), the paper finds that institutional quality, human capital development, trade openness, and macroeconomic policies are associated with higher levels of real GDP per capita. The results suggest that stronger governance frameworks and investment in human capital are associated with higher income levels in Mauritius and Seychelles, while more persistent institutional and structural challenges are associated with lower income levels in Madagascar and Comoros. Overall, the findings suggest the importance of institutions, human capital, and external integration in economic performance across the four Indian Ocean island economies.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了自1980年以来毛里求斯、塞舌尔、马达加斯加和科摩罗四国经济发展的分化路径。尽管这些国家处于大致相似的区域和地理环境中，毛里求斯和塞舌尔实现了显著更高的人均实际GDP水平，而马达加斯加和科摩罗的进展则较为有限。结合定性分析与面板计量经济学方法（FMOLS和DOLS），本文发现制度质量、人力资本发展、贸易开放度及宏观经济政策与更高的人均实际GDP水平相关联。结果表明，更强的治理框架和人力资本投资与毛里求斯和塞舌尔的较高收入水平相关，而更持久的制度和结构性挑战则与马达加斯加和科摩罗的较低收入水平相关。总体而言，研究结果强调了制度、人力资本和外部融合在四个印度洋岛屿经济体经济表现中的重要性。
